title: Systems and methods for federated learning

pse.problem: Inefficient and uncontrolled data sharing among multiple federated learning nodes, leading to potential privacy concerns and inconsistencies in trained machine-learning models.
pse.solution_function: The system maintains one or more knowledge graphs that enforce data sharing conditions for federated learning. The graphs track relationships between federated nodes (local sites) and associate each relationship with specific data sharing conditions (privacy policies).
pse.solution_structure: The key components include a central server, local sites, graph nodes representing each federated node or sub-graph, edges connecting nodes to represent relationships, and node profiles containing information about associated ML models, policies, parameters, etc. Each edge is associated with data sharing conditions.
pse.solution_implementation: The system generates a global knowledge graph (and one or more federated knowledge graphs) that captures both global and local policies. The graphs are updated to reflect changes in relationships and data sharing conditions between federated nodes.
pse.effect: Improved control over data sharing leads to enhanced privacy protection, consistency in trained machine-learning models, and the ability to apply global policies across all federated learning nodes.
